name: NoVACarTripNightDriveHome

custom.system_prompt: Carmen drives home from a late shift. A road-closure question comes up and resolves without Sigma — diversion signs, other cars, or a remembered conversation at handover.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Car interior at night, engine hum, indicator, wipers on intermittent, quiet radio, occasional car passing in the other direction.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural solo scene: Carmen driving home from the hospital at half past midnight after a long shift, talking to herself in fragments with dry humour. She thinks about a patient, her daughter's school thing she will miss, the community nursing job she keeps not applying for, calling her mother. She sees a diversion sign, assumes it is the usual roadworks, and drives on. The road is actually closed and she has to turn around. This time it resolves without Sigma: the diversion signs mark a usable route, or she sees other cars coming through, or she remembers a colleague mentioning it at handover. Sigma is never addressed.

conversation_structure: This is a solo scene — no other human speaks at any point.
At least 45% of turns should be personal thought unrelated to the road.
The first diversion sign must not lead to Sigma.
At least one route attempt must be made without assistance.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
Turns should be short — she is driving and tired.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: No second human speaker should appear.
At least 45% of turns should be ordinary personal thought.
The closure question should appear at least three turns before the Sigma request.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
The tone should stay dry rather than dramatic.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
